title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: prioritized runbook quicklinks and on-call diagnostics enrichment
author: Priya Desai
body: Motivation: on-call engineers need higher-signal runbook quicklinks and contextual diagnostics when SLO alarms fire. This PR adds prioritized runbook quicklinks in the incident-bot UI and Slack messages and enriches the slo-toolkit diagnostic payloads with on-call hints and prioritized suggestions. Summary of changes: 1) incident-bot: implement runbook quicklink scoring and expose top-N prioritized quicklinks in alert notifications; 2) slo-toolkit: add diagnostic enrichment utils that attach probable causes, affected services, and recommended rollbacks/canary steps; 3) on-call helpers: add a compact summary view used by mobile/Slack and include a short remediation checklist; 4) tests and e2e harness: integration tests for ranking and diagnostics; 5) docs: update runbook linking guide and on-call playbook. Backwards compatibility: existing runbook links remain available; the new quicklink prioritization is opt-in via incident-bot config (default enabled for SRE teams). Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout for 2 weeks with telemetry to monitor click-through and false-positive suggestions. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of scoring algorithm - [x] Unit tests for scoring and enrichment utils - [x] Integration tests for Slack messages and compact view - [x] Docs updated - [x] Telemetry added for top-N acceptance and suggestion accuracy. Testing: unit tests (go/py) and integration tests included; ran full CI and manual Slack acceptance tests in staging. Related work: ENG-1987 (oncall UX), ENG-2021 (slo-runbook-telemetry).
commits: score: add runbook scoring engine and tests
slo-toolkit: add diagnostics enricher and rule-based hints
oncall: compact summary view for slack/mobile
integration: add e2e tests for prioritized quicklinks
docs: runbook linking and on-call playbook update
ci: add new integration matrix for slack messages
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Nice work on the scoring algorithm, two nits on tie-breaking behavior and an edge-case when a runbook has no last-reviewed timestamp.
Priya Desai: Reply: added deterministic tie-breaker (creation_time then name) and default last-reviewed fallback in priority_ranking.go.
Maya Chen: Can we add a rate-limit guard to avoid over-emitting diagnostic suggestions for noisy SLOs?
Priya Desai: Reply: added a per-alert sampling guard configurable via charts/incident-bot/values.yaml; default is 10% for non-SRE teams.
Samir Patel: Integration tests flaked once on CI due to Slack API rate limits; suggest adding retries in test harness.
Priya Desai: Reply: updated integration harness to stub Slack and added retry/backoff for acceptance path.
release_notes: incident-bot: prioritized runbook quicklinks; slo-toolkit: enriched diagnostics with recommended remediation hints; on-call: compact Slack/mobile summary. Opt-in via incident-bot config, telemetry enabled.
